not afraid of the dark no more enjoy playing games with it if its gonna play games with me bring it on  **Not Afraid of the Dark No More**
*Filthy fun Coffeebreak style — cheeky, loud, a bit dirty, and ready to scrap*

**Verse 1**
Used to hide under the covers when the lights went out
Heart hammering like a cheap drum kit, whispering “don’t come out”
Now I kick the door wide open, grin like I just won the lot
Darkness, you old bastard, I remember every game you taught

You used to sneak up quiet, steal the air right out my chest
Now I steal it back and laugh, put my boots up on your desk
If you’re gonna play games with me, better bring a bigger stick
I ain’t running from the shadows — I’m the one who makes them tick

**Chorus**
Not afraid of the dark no more, I enjoy playing games with it
If it’s gonna play games with me, then baby bring it on
Turn the lights off, lock the door, let’s get filthy, let’s get wrong
Coffeebreak after midnight, pour it black and drink it strong
Not afraid of the dark no more — I dance with it till dawn
Bring it on, you sneaky thing, I already know your song

**Verse 2**
You used to wear my fear like a cheap leather jacket
Now I wear yours better, look how good it hangs on my back
We play hide and seek in the hallway, I never hide that long
I find you first, I pin you down, I write you into my song

You throw the same old tricks, the creak, the whisper, the cold
I throw them back twice as filthy and twice as uncontrolled
If this is a game of chicken, sweetheart, I don’t blink first
I stare straight into the black and I tell it “do your worst”

**Chorus**
Not afraid of the dark no more, I enjoy playing games with it
If it’s gonna play games with me, then baby bring it on
Turn the lights off, lock the door, let’s get filthy, let’s get wrong
Coffeebreak after midnight, pour it black and drink it strong
Not afraid of the dark no more — I dance with it till dawn
Bring it on, you sneaky thing, I already know your song

**Bridge**
Used to think the dark was winning every single night
Now I know it just wanted someone who would fight
So I fight it with a smirk and a filthy little laugh
Then I kiss it on the mouth and I split the prize in half

**Final Chorus**
Not afraid of the dark no more, I enjoy playing games with it
If it’s gonna play games with me, then baby bring it on
Turn the lights off, lock the door, let’s get filthy, let’s get wrong
Coffeebreak after midnight — this is where I belong
Not afraid of the dark no more, I own the damn thing now
Bring it on, bring it on, bring it on — I’ll show you how

### 🎷💋 **NOTRE PETIT SECRET, 1930** ☕🎀
Deux corps qui se rapprochent, le souffle court, les mains qui se cherchent, le satin qui glisse sous la lumière tamisée, et cette tension brûlante entre deux amoureux qui n'ont plus envie de résister. 🎷🎀💋### 🎷💋 **OUR LITTLE SECRET, 1930** ☕🎀Common pieces included:
Girdles: shaped the waist, hips and abdomen
Corselettes: combined bust and waist shaping into one garment
Step-in garments: worn like shorts and pulled on from the feet
Bust bodices: supported and shaped the bust
Waist cinchers: focused specifically on the waist
Suspender belts: held stockings up
Silk or rayon slips: worn underneath dresses
The silhouette was generally less dramatically hourglass-shaped than earlier decades. The fashionable 1930s figure was long, slender and softly defined.
🩷 The “salmon satin” look
For your CoffeeBreak character, a particularly period-inspired ensemble could be:
Salmon-pink satin bias-cut evening gown
matching silk slip
light corselette underneath
seamed stockings
satin pumps
long gloves
pearls
small evening bag
Hollywood-style waves
That would give you a very convincing 1930s supper-club / dance-hall aesthetic rather than a modern costume pretending to be vintage. 🎷🍓☕

Two hearts racing, bodies drawing near,
Breath getting shorter, nothing left to fear.
Salmon satin glowing underneath the light,
Whispers getting softer as we slip into the night.

Chocolate melting, strawberries sweet,
Caramel latte and a slow jazz beat.
Your hands find mine, the whole room fades,
Two lovers caught in the games their hearts have made.

**Hold me closer, darling, don't say a word,**
Let the gramophone play until our hearts are heard.
One stolen kiss, then another one too,
Nineteen-thirty feels brand new with you.

The curtains are falling, the lights are down low,
There's nowhere to hurry and nowhere to go.
Just you and me in the candlelight glow,
Wrapped up in satin while the old records flow.

[Whispered outro]
Close the door, darling...
Let the music play.
Tonight, we're keeping our little secret. 🎷💋

[Intro, murmuré]
Chéri...
Ferme la porte.
Laisse jouer le gramophone.

[Couplet 1]
Satin couleur saumon, rubans noués,
Un sourire coquin que je ne peux cacher,
Le chocolat fond sous la lumière du soir,
Tu me rapproches doucement dans le noir.

Latte au caramel, deux tasses bien chaudes,
Le jazz résonne pendant que la nuit rôde,
Tes yeux racontent ce que tes lèvres ne disent pas,
Et pourtant, je continue de danser avec toi.

[Refrain]
Tu es mon petit secret, mon amour,
Ma chanson interdite de minuit,
Joue joue contre joue sous la lune,
Pendant que le vieux gramophone nous sourit.

Embrasse-moi doucement, vole encore un baiser,
Garde-moi près de toi, ne me laisse pas partir,
Nous sommes deux cœurs un peu déraisonnables,
Dans la douce lumière de 1930.

[Couplet 2]
Crème à la fraise posée sur la table,
Deux amoureux faisant semblant d'être raisonnables,
Mais chaque regard révèle tout,
Et mon cœur s'emballe quand je pense à nous.

Corset de satin, perles scintillantes,
Ta main trouve la mienne, la nuit devient troublante,
La salle de bal disparaît peu à peu,
Et soudain, il n'y a plus que nous deux.

[Pont]
Chut, mon chéri, ne dis plus un mot,
Laisse le vieux jazz tourner tout là-haut,
Un petit sourire, un murmure : « Reste avec moi »,
Et toutes nos bonnes résolutions s'en vont déjà.

[Dernier refrain]
Tu es mon petit secret, mon amour,
Mon doux rendez-vous après minuit,
Baisers chocolat, rêves de caramel,
Et ton parfum qui flotte dans la nuit.

Danse avec moi jusqu'au matin,
Laisse dormir toute la vieille ville,
1930, toi et moi,
Avec des promesses un peu difficiles à tenir.

[Outro, murmuré]
Même heure demain, chéri ?
J'apporte les fraises...
Tu apportes le café. ☕🍓💋

### 🎭 COFFEEBREAK: THE STAGE GAME

**1. The slow reveal**
Don't give everything away immediately. Start with silhouette, lighting, music, then gradually reveal the costume or choreography.

**2. The tease-and-pause**
Build anticipation, then deliberately pause. A performer might freeze, smile at the crowd, take a sip of coffee, and let the audience wonder what comes next.

**3. Eye contact**
Look directly toward different parts of the room, then deliberately look away. It creates the feeling that the performer is playing with the audience's attention.

**4. Misdirection**
Point toward one side of the stage, make everyone look there, then appear somewhere completely different.

**5. Call-and-response**
“Coffee!”
Audience: **“BREAK!”**

“Pink!”
Audience: **“CHAOS!”**

Now the audience isn't just watching. They're participating.

**6. The cliffhanger**
Just when everyone expects the big finale:

> “You thought THAT was the finale?”

Music cuts.

Blackout.

Then the beat comes back.

🏀☕💗 **ROUND TWO.**

**7. The payoff**
The most important trick is actually delivering the promised moment. Tease → anticipation → reveal → payoff.

### 💗 CoffeeBreak formula

**TEASE → PAUSE → SURPRISE → INTERACTION → PAYOFF**

The performer isn't controlling people's minds. They're controlling the **rhythm of attention**, turning the performance into a little game where everyone wants to discover the next move.

# Pink Pigtails

**Verse 1**
Pink pigtails, satin tails,
Twirling through a candy trail.
Cherry gloss and bubblegum dreams,
Nothing's ever quite as it seems.

Big plums swing in the summer breeze,
Dancing with the honeybees.
Cotton clouds and carousel skies,
Sparkle stars in my bright eyes.

**Pre-Chorus**
Spin me round, don't slow me down,
I'm the queen of this little town.
Sugar steps on a glitter floor,
Every heartbeat wanting more.

**Chorus**
Pink pigtails, satin tails,
Fairy dust and happy trails.
Laugh so loud, sing so free,
Paint the whole world candy pink with me.

Pink pigtails, satin shine,
Every little moment's mine.
Pop-pop hearts and plum delight,
We're turning every day into Friday night.

**Verse 2**
Bubble beats and neon lights,
Coffee cups and sweet delights.
Every smile's a shooting star,
Magic follows where we are.

**Bridge**
Clap your hands, let the rhythm bloom,
Flowers dancing round the room.
Every color finds its place,
Joy is written on my face.

**Final Chorus**
Pink pigtails, satin tails,
Dreams arriving without fail.
Sing it high beneath the moon,
Summer never ends too soon.

Pink pigtails, satin glow,
Everywhere the good vibes flow.
Raise your cup and dance away,
We'll make the world a sweeter place today.
